answer_text:
Here are some of the best websites to buy beauty products online (good selection, reliable fulfillment, and strong return policies). I’ll group them by what they’re best for.

## Best all-around (wide selection + easy returns)
- **Sephora** – Strong mix of prestige brands, great samples/rewards, solid returns.
- **Ulta Beauty** – Prestige + drugstore in one cart, frequent promos/coupons, rewards.
- **Nordstrom Beauty** – Great service, easy returns, good curated selection.

## Best for deals (legit products, frequent discounts)
- **Dermstore** – Often strong promotions on skincare/derm brands.
- **Lookfantastic** – Regular sales, bundles, and beauty boxes (selection varies).
- **Target / Walmart (sold & shipped by the retailer)** – Convenient for drugstore staples; just watch the seller (avoid unknown marketplace sellers).

## Best for K-beauty / J-beauty
- **YesStyle** – Huge Asian-beauty catalog; shipping can be slower.
- **Stylevana** – Great prices; shipping timing varies a lot by item.
- **Olive Young Global** – Popular Korean retailer; good for trending K-beauty.

## Best for “clean” / indie brands
- **Credo Beauty** – Strong “clean” curation, many indie brands.
- **Beautylish** – Great for pro/indie brands; dependable shipping/packaging.

## Best for professional hair + tools
- **Sally Beauty** – Hair color, treatments, and tools; lots of pro-oriented options.
- **CosmoProf** (if you have access) – Pro salon brands (often license-restricted).

## Best for fragrance
- **LuckyScent** – Excellent niche fragrance selection/decants.
- **The brands’ own sites** (Chanel, Dior, etc.) – Best for authenticity and full product lines.

### Quick safety tips (to avoid fakes/old stock)
- Prefer **brand websites** or **authorized retailers**.
- On Amazon/Walmart/other marketplaces, buy **“Sold by and shipped by”** the retailer (or the brand’s official storefront), not random third-party sellers.
- Check return windows for **opened** items—policies differ.

If you tell me your budget (drugstore vs prestige), what you’re buying (skincare/makeup/hair/fragrance), and whether you want “clean” or K-beauty, I can narrow this to a top 5 for you.
